resources.string: Wireless debugging pairing
Enter 6-digit pairing code
Enter code
Enter wireless debugging pairing code
Keep the system pairing dialog open and enter the 6-digit code here.
Pairing code received
Submitting the pairing code to the system pairing service. Keep this screen open.
Pairing code received. Waiting for the wireless debugging pairing port.
Pairing succeeded
Wireless debugging pairing is complete.
Wireless debugging pairing did not finish
Wireless debugging connection failed
Droidance needs to pair again
The current ADB pairing authorization is no longer accepted. Tap to open Developer options, then pair again from Wireless debugging.
The pairing code must be 6 digits. Please enter it again.
No active pairing request is available. Open wireless debugging settings again and enter the system pairing dialog.
Allow Droidance notifications before entering the pairing code from the notification shade.
Droidance notifications are disabled. Enable them in system settings first.
The Wireless debugging pairing notification category cannot pop up. Enable alerts for it in system settings first.
The pairing notification could not be posted. Check system notification settings and try again.
The pairing input was not received. Keep the system pairing dialog open and enter the code again in the notification.
Android rejected the current ADB pairing key. Open Wireless debugging › Pair device with pairing code and pair again.
No Wi-Fi transport is available. Pairing is still valid, and Droidance will retry when Wi-Fi returns.
No pairing service was found. Allow Droidance to run in the background, reopen the system pairing dialog, and enter the new code in the notification.
Pairing timed out. Reopen the system pairing dialog to get a new code.
Android rejected the pairing. Get a new pairing code and try again.
Could not connect to the system pairing service. Get a new pairing code and try again.
The wireless ADB bridge health check failed. Try again shortly.
The wireless ADB bridge did not return a valid response. Try again shortly.
Could not verify the wireless ADB shell identity. Try again shortly.
The wireless ADB shell identity response was invalid. Try again shortly.
The wireless ADB connection failed. Make sure Wireless debugging is still on.
No wireless ADB endpoint was found. Make sure Wireless debugging is on.
Standard control channel disconnected
Open Droidance to check the connection, and enable Wi-Fi and wireless debugging. Pair again if authorization has expired.
Root control channel disconnected
Open Droidance to check Root access and reconnect the device.
Could not confirm that the debugging port is closed. Pairing and port records were kept; reconnect with Wi-Fi and try again.
Could not connect to the local debugging port. Keep USB debugging enabled and approve the system debugging authorization prompt.
Enter a port from 1 to 65535.
Shizuku control channel disconnected
Open Droidance to check Shizuku service and authorization, then reconnect the device.
